desc.p: Maps SNOMED CT vaccine products to a SNOMED CT route of administration. Source is the value set Vaccine Product extensional (SNOMED) (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.10), target the intensional route value set (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.16). Unlike the medicinal products of concept map 24.5, vaccine product concepts carry no 411116001 |Has manufactured dose form|, so the route cannot be derived from the dose form and is stated here instead. It is not invented: the route follows from the vaccine itself and is given in the summary of product characteristics. 20 rows, covering the targets of the concept map CVX to SNOMED-CT Vaccine Products (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.24.3). The body site is a different matter and is held separately, see the code system Synthetic administration site (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.5.3).
